newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light nearby trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light nearby trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw only light nearby trade this afternoon despite a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening, market sources said.

"There was little faith in the market today. A higher dollar and calls for a slightly weaker soymeal futures opening also kept a lid on activity ahead of the weekend with only a few hand-to-mouth deals done. The firmer Chicago soymeal futures opening came too late for European dealers to react," one broker said.
Argentine sunmeal pellets traded $1 up from yesterday at $147 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
